angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 340,893 km at 143.53 pc = 0.03 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 6.9672 +/- 0.0270 mas (same row, RUWE 1.05): 143.53 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.49 +/- 0.011 solar radii from Hotnisky et al. 2025, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-6330 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025AJ....170....1H/abstract): 340,893 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.531 +/- 0.021 solar masses from Hotnisky et al. 2025, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-6330 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025AJ....170....1H/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 3539 +/- 59 K from Hotnisky et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-6330 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025AJ....170....1H/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Hotnisky et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-6330 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025AJ....170....1H/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-6330.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.783, rounded to two decimals
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-6330 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.08 dex, from Hotnisky et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025AJ....170....1H/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-6330 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -1.43168, from Hotnisky et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025AJ....170....1H/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-6330 (pscomppars): age 7.6 Gyr, from Hotnisky et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025AJ....170....1H/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-6330 (pscomppars): rotation period 36 d, from Hotnisky et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025AJ....170....1H/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-6330 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 2 km/s, from Hotnisky et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025AJ....170....1H/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
